# PRD: NUTRI-SHARE — Platform Distribusi Pangan Berbasis Gizi

| Metadata | |
|---|---|
| **Versi** | 2.0.0 |
| **Status** | Final |
| **Tanggal** | 2026-07-07 |
| **Tech Stack** | Python FastAPI + React TypeScript + SQLite |

---

## 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif

NUTRI-SHARE adalah platform distribusi surplus pangan yang menghubungkan **donor** (Hotel/Restoran/Kafe) dengan **penerima** (Panti Asuhan/Lembaga Sosial) menggunakan algoritma **Hybrid Entropy-TOPSIS** untuk menentukan prioritas penerima berdasarkan kebutuhan gizi.

### 1.1 Tujuan

1. Mengurangi food waste dengan menyalurkan surplus pangan bergizi
2. Memastikan makanan bernutrisi tinggi sampai ke yang paling membutuhkan
3. Memberikan transparansi penuh dalam proses donasi
4. Mendukung SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) dan SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption)

### 1.2 Target Pengguna

| Segmen | Contoh | Kebutuhan |
|--------|--------|-----------|
| **Donor** | Hotel, Restoran, Kafe, Katering | Publikasi surplus pangan, tracking donasi |
| **Penerima** | Panti Asuhan, Rumah Singgah, Lembaga Sosial | Klaim donasi, monitoring gizi |
| **Admin** | Pengelola platform | Verifikasi, approve, monitoring |
| **Publik** | Masyarakat umum | Lihat statistik, top donor |

---

## 2. Perangkat Keras & Lingkungan

| Komponen | Spesifikasi |
|----------|-------------|
| **Runtime** | Python 3.12+ |
| **Framework** | FastAPI 0.139+ |
| **Database** | SQLite 3 + WAL mode |
| **Frontend** | React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript 5.8 |
| **CSS** | TailwindCSS v4 |
| **Map** | Leaflet + react-leaflet |
| **Animasi** | Motion (framer-motion) |

---

## 3. Arsitektur Sistem

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   FRONTEND                        │
│         React 19 + Vite + TailwindCSS             │
│         http://localhost:5173                      │
└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                      │ HTTP / JSON / SSE
                      ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   BACKEND API                     │
│        FastAPI + Uvicorn + SQLModel               │
│        http://localhost:3000                       │
└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                      │
                      ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              DATABASE SQLite (.db)                 │
│    10 tabel: users, donations, topsis, dll        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 4. Database — 10 Tabel

### 4.1 Tabel Users

| Field | Tipe | Keterangan |
|-------|------|------------|
| id | INT PK | Auto increment |
| name | TEXT | Nama lengkap |
| email | TEXT UNIQUE | Email login |
| password | TEXT | bcrypt hash |
| role | TEXT | `donor` / `recipient` / `admin` |
| status | TEXT | `pending` / `verified` / `rejected` |
| reset_token | TEXT? | Token reset password |
| reset_token_expiry | TEXT? | Kadaluarsa token |

### 4.2 Tabel Donor Profiles

| Field | Tipe | Keterangan |
|-------|------|------------|
| user_id | INT FK | Relasi ke users |
| business_name | TEXT | Nama bisnis |
| business_type | TEXT | `hotel` / `restoran` / `kafe` / `katering` / `lainnya` |
| address | TEXT | Alamat lengkap |
| latitude | REAL | Koordinat pickup |
| longitude | REAL | Koordinat pickup |
| phone | TEXT | No. telepon |
| logo_url | TEXT | URL logo |
| total_donations | INT | Total donasi (counter) |

### 4.3 Tabel Recipient Profiles

| Field | Tipe | Keterangan |
|-------|------|------------|
| user_id | INT FK | Relasi ke users |
| institution_name | TEXT | Nama lembaga |
| institution_type | TEXT | `panti_asuhan` / `rumah_singgah` / `lembaga_sosial` / `lainnya` |
| address | TEXT | Alamat |
| latitude | REAL | Koordinat |
| longitude | REAL | Koordinat |
| phone | TEXT | No. telepon |
| resident_count | INT | Jumlah penghuni |
| age_range | TEXT | Rentang usia |
| health_condition | TEXT | Kondisi kesehatan |
| daily_protein_need | REAL | Kebutuhan protein/hari (g) |
| daily_calorie_need | REAL | Kebutuhan kalori/hari (kkal) |
| daily_iron_need | REAL | Kebutuhan zat besi/hari (mg) |
| daily_vitamin_c_need | REAL | Kebutuhan vitamin C/hari (mg) |
| urgency_score | INT | 1-5, skor urgensi |
| emergency | TEXT | `none` / `pending` / `active` |

### 4.4 Tabel Donations

| Field | Tipe | Keterangan |
|-------|------|------------|
| id | INT PK | Auto increment |
| donor_id | INT FK | Pembuat donasi |
| food_name | TEXT | Nama makanan |
| food_type | TEXT | `makanan_berat` / `sayur` / `lauk_protein` / `snack` / `minuman` / `lainnya` |
| portion_count | INT | Jumlah porsi |
| protein_per_portion | REAL | Protein per porsi (g) |
| calorie_per_portion | REAL | Kalori per porsi (kkal) |
| iron_mg | REAL? | Zat besi per porsi (mg) |
| vitamin_c_mg | REAL? | Vitamin C per porsi (mg) |
| valid_until | TEXT | Batas layak konsumsi |
| pickup_latitude | REAL | Lokasi pickup |
| pickup_longitude | REAL | Lokasi pickup |
| status | TEXT | `active` / `claimed` / `completed` / `expired` |
| claimed_by | INT? | ID penerima yang klaim |
| arrived_at | TEXT? | Waktu konfirmasi sampai |
| completed_at | TEXT? | Waktu selesai |
| created_at | TEXT | Waktu dibuat |

### 4.5 Tabel Claims

| Field | Tipe | Keterangan |
|-------|------|------------|
| donation_id | INT FK | Donasi yang diklaim |
| recipient_id | INT FK | Penerima yang klaim |
| topsis_rank_at_claim | INT | Peringkat TOPSIS saat klaim |
| status | TEXT | `pending` / `approved` / `rejected` |
| reviewed_by | INT? | Admin yang review |

### 4.6 Tabel Topsis Results

| Field | Tipe | Keterangan |
|-------|------|------------|
| donation_id | INT FK | Donasi |
| recipient_id | INT FK | Penerima |
| rank_position | INT | Peringkat |
| raw_c1..c5 | REAL | Nilai mentah 5 kriteria |
| d_plus, d_minus | REAL | Jarak dari solusi ideal |
| ci_score | REAL | Skor closeness coefficient |

### 4.7 Tabel Notifications

| Field | Tipe | Keterangan |
|-------|------|------------|
| user_id | INT FK | Target notif |
| title | TEXT | Judul |
| message | TEXT | Isi pesan |
| type | TEXT | `donation_available` / `claim_approved` / `verification` / `system` |
| is_read | INT | 0/1 |
| related_donation_id | INT? | Donasi terkait |

### 4.8 Tabel Reviews

| Field | Tipe | Keterangan |
|-------|------|------------|
| donation_id | INT FK | Donasi |
| donor_id | INT FK | Donor dinilai |
| recipient_id | INT FK | Pemberi ulasan |
| rating | INT | 1-5 |
| comment | TEXT | Komentar |

### 4.9 Tabel Activity Logs

| Field | Tipe | Keterangan |
|-------|------|------------|
| user_id | INT | Pelaku |

## 7. Modul Auth & Keamanan

## 8. Modul TOPSIS Algorithm

### 8.1 5 Kriteria

| Kode | Kriteria | Tipe | Sumber Data |
|------|----------|------|-------------|
| C1 | Densitas Protein | Benefit (max) | `protein_per_portion * portion_count / recipien.daily_protein_need` |
| C2 | Urgensi Kesehatan | Benefit (max) | `urgency_score` (×1000 jika emergency active) |
| C3 | Kelayakan Pangan | Benefit (max) | Sisa jam sebelum `valid_until` |
| C4 | Jangkauan Lokasi | Cost (min) | Jarak haversine (pickup → recipient) |
| C5 | Riwayat Bantuan | Benefit (max) | Hari sejak `last_received_donation` |

### 8.2 Proses

```
1. Normalisasi matriks (vector normalization)
2. Hitung entropy tiap kriteria → bobot (Shannon Entropy)
3. Weighted normalized matrix
4. Hitung solusi ideal (A+ / A-)
5. Euclidean distance (D+ / D-)
6. Closeness coefficient: Ci = D- / (D+ + D-)
7. Ranking: Ci tertinggi = prioritas #1
```

---

| `donation_available` | Donasi dipublikasi | Semua penerima verified |
| `claim_approved` | Admin setujui klaim | Donor + penerima |
| `verification` | Admin verifikasi user | User |
| `system` | Klaim baru, emergency, dll | Admin |

**Metode:** SSE (Server-Sent Events) via `GET /api/notifications/subscribe?user_id=N`
- 30s keepalive ping
- Async queue per user

## 11. Flow Bisnis

### 11.1 Flow Donasi Lengkap

```
DONOR                          SISTEM                      PENERIMA
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Register                    │                            ├─ Register
  ├─ Diverifikasi admin          │                            ├─ Diverifikasi admin

  │    • porsi, protein, kalori  ├── TOPSIS Ranking           │
  │    • lokasi pickup           │    • C1-C5 + Entropy       │
  │    • masa berlaku            │    • CI Score              │
  │                              │    • Rank #1, #2, #3...    │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄────────── Lihat Aktif ────┤
  │                              │    • TOPSIS rank           │
  │                              │    • CI score              │
  │                              │    • Jarak, urgensi        │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄─────────── Klaim ─────────┤
  │                              │    • Priority #1           │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │── Notif Admin ────────────►│
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄── Admin Approve ──────────┤
  │                              │    • Status → claimed      │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄── Konfirmasi Sampai ──────┤
  │                              │    • arrived_at diisi      │
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Konfirmasi Selesai ────────►│                            │
  │    • Status → completed      │                            │
  │    • Donasi +1               │                            │
  │    • Badge update            │                            │
  │                              │                            │
  │◄────────── Lihat Ulasan ─────┤◄─────────── Review ────────┤
  │    • Rating & komentar       │    • Rating 1-5            │
  │    • Badge "Favorit"         │    • Komentar               │
```

# PRD: NUTRI-SHARE — Platform Distribusi Pangan Berbasis Gizi

| Metadata | |

## 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif

NUTRI-SHARE adalah platform distribusi surplus pangan yang menghubungkan **donor** (Hotel/Restoran/Kafe) dengan **penerima** (Panti Asuhan/Lembaga Sosial) menggunakan algoritma **Hybrid Entropy-TOPSIS** untuk menentukan prioritas penerima berdasarkan kebutuhan gizi.

### 1.1 Tujuan

1. Mengurangi food waste dengan menyalurkan surplus pangan bergizi
2. Memastikan makanan bernutrisi tinggi sampai ke yang paling membutuhkan
3. Memberikan transparansi penuh dalam proses donasi
4. Mendukung SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) dan SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption)

### 1.2 Target Pengguna

| Segmen | Contoh | Kebutuhan |
|--------|--------|-----------|
| **Donor** | Hotel, Restoran, Kafe, Katering | Publikasi surplus pangan, tracking donasi |
| **Penerima** | Panti Asuhan, Rumah Singgah, Lembaga Sosial | Klaim donasi, monitoring gizi |
| **Admin** | Pengelola platform | Verifikasi, approve, monitoring |
| **Publik** | Masyarakat umum | Lihat statistik, top donor |

| `/admin` | AdminDashboard | Admin | Stats overview, grafik tren 7 hari, verifikasi user, setujui klaim, kelola darurat, hapus user, pencarian global, log aktivitas, dark mode toggle |

| `*` | NotFound | 404, navigasi pulang |

### 6.5 Komponen Bersama

| Komponen | Lokasi | Fungsi |
|----------|--------|--------|
| Navbar | `components/Navbar.tsx` | Navigasi, dark mode, mobile drawer |
| Footer | `components/Footer.tsx` | Informasi footer |
| LiveTrackingModal | `components/LiveTrackingModal.tsx` | Tracking kurir di peta (simulasi) |
| ProfileModal | `components/ProfileModal.tsx` | Edit profil user |
| ReviewModal | `components/ReviewModal.tsx` | Form ulasan |

| ConfirmDialog | `components/ConfirmDialog.tsx` | Dialog konfirmasi |
| SEO | `components/SEO.tsx` | SEO head manager |

---

## 7. Modul Auth & Keamanan

### 7.1 Autentikasi

| Aspek | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Metode** | JWT (HS256) via httpOnly cookie |
| **Nama Cookie** | `nutrishare_token` |
| **Expiry** | 7 hari |
| **Secure** | true di production |
| **SameSite** | Lax |

### 7.2 Otorisasi

| Guard | Middleware | Kapan |
|-------|-----------|-------|
| Login | `get_current_user` | Semua endpoint /api yang butuh auth |
| Role donor | `require_role("donor")` | Buat donasi |
| Role penerima | `require_role("recipient")` | Klaim donasi, history |
| Role admin | `require_role("admin")` | Admin endpoints |

### 7.3 Validasi Input

| Layer | Tool |
|-------|------|
| Backend | Pydantic v2 (auto validasi + custom messages) |
| Frontend | `lib/validation.tsx` (required, email, password) |

### 7.4 Keamanan Response

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| X-Content-Type-Options | nosniff |
| X-Frame-Options | DENY |
| Referrer-Policy | strict-origin-when-cross-origin |
| HSTS | max-age=31536000 (production) |

---

## 8. Modul TOPSIS Algorithm

### 8.1 5 Kriteria

| Kode | Kriteria | Tipe | Sumber Data |
|------|----------|------|-------------|
| C1 | Densitas Protein | Benefit (max) | `protein_per_portion * portion_count / recipien.daily_protein_need` |
| C2 | Urgensi Kesehatan | Benefit (max) | `urgency_score` (×1000 jika emergency active) |
| C3 | Kelayakan Pangan | Benefit (max) | Sisa jam sebelum `valid_until` |
| C4 | Jangkauan Lokasi | Cost (min) | Jarak haversine (pickup → recipient) |
| C5 | Riwayat Bantuan | Benefit (max) | Hari sejak `last_received_donation` |

### 8.2 Proses

```
1. Normalisasi matriks (vector normalization)
2. Hitung entropy tiap kriteria → bobot (Shannon Entropy)
3. Weighted normalized matrix
4. Hitung solusi ideal (A+ / A-)
5. Euclidean distance (D+ / D-)
6. Closeness coefficient: Ci = D- / (D+ + D-)
7. Ranking: Ci tertinggi = prioritas #1
```

---

## 9. Modul Notifikasi Real-Time

| Tipe | Trigger | Penerima |
|------|---------|----------|
| `donation_available` | Donasi dipublikasi | Semua penerima verified |
| `claim_approved` | Admin setujui klaim | Donor + penerima |
| `verification` | Admin verifikasi user | User |
| `system` | Klaim baru, emergency, dll | Admin |

**Metode:** SSE (Server-Sent Events) via `GET /api/notifications/subscribe?user_id=N`
- 30s keepalive ping
- Async queue per user

---

## 10. Modul Gamification

### 10.1 Badges

| Badge | Syarat |
|-------|--------|
| 🌱 Donator Pemula | ≥ 1 donasi |
| ⭐ Donator Aktif | ≥ 5 donasi |
| 🏆 Pahlawan Pangan | ≥ 10 donasi |
| 👑 Legenda Donasi | ≥ 20 donasi |
| ❤️ Favorit Penerima | ≥ 5 ulasan |

### 10.2 Top Donors

3 besar donor publik di halaman Pahlawan berdasarkan `total_donations` DESC + rating.

---

## 11. Flow Bisnis

### 11.1 Flow Donasi Lengkap

```
DONOR                          SISTEM                      PENERIMA
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Register                    │                            ├─ Register
  ├─ Diverifikasi admin          │                            ├─ Diverifikasi admin
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Login                       │                            ├─ Login
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Buat Donasi ───────────────►│                            │
  │    • nama makanan            │                            │
  │    • porsi, protein, kalori  ├── TOPSIS Ranking           │
  │    • lokasi pickup           │    • C1-C5 + Entropy       │
  │    • masa berlaku            │    • CI Score              │
  │                              │    • Rank #1, #2, #3...    │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄────────── Lihat Aktif ────┤
  │                              │    • TOPSIS rank           │
  │                              │    • CI score              │
  │                              │    • Jarak, urgensi        │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄─────────── Klaim ─────────┤
  │                              │    • Priority #1           │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │── Notif Admin ────────────►│
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄── Admin Approve ──────────┤
  │                              │    • Status → claimed      │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄── Konfirmasi Sampai ──────┤
  │                              │    • arrived_at diisi      │
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Konfirmasi Selesai ────────►│                            │
  │    • Status → completed      │                            │
  │    • Donasi +1               │                            │
  │    • Badge update            │                            │
  │                              │                            │
  │◄────────── Lihat Ulasan ─────┤◄─────────── Review ────────┤
  │    • Rating & komentar       │    • Rating 1-5            │
  │    • Badge "Favorit"         │    • Komentar               │
```

### 11.2 Flow Status Donasi

```
active ──► claimed ──► (arrived) ──► completed
   │                                      ▲
   └──► expired (jika lewat valid_until)  │
                                          │
  User bisa lihat notifikasi SSE real-time
```

| **Responsif** | Desktop-first, mobile compatible |

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Ringkasan Eksekutif & Arsitektur

| Metadata | |
|---|---|
| **Versi** | 2.0.0 |
| **Status** | Final |
| **Tanggal** | 2026-07-07 |

## 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif

NUTRI-SHARE adalah platform distribusi surplus pangan yang menghubungkan **donor** (Hotel/Restoran/Kafe) dengan **penerima** (Panti Asuhan/Lembaga Sosial) menggunakan algoritma **Hybrid Entropy-TOPSIS** untuk menentukan prioritas penerima berdasarkan kebutuhan gizi.

### 1.1 Tujuan

1. Mengurangi food waste dengan menyalurkan surplus pangan bergizi
2. Memastikan makanan bernutrisi tinggi sampai ke yang paling membutuhkan
3. Memberikan transparansi penuh dalam proses donasi
4. Mendukung SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) dan SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption)

### 1.2 Target Pengguna

| Segmen | Contoh | Kebutuhan |
|--------|--------|-----------|
| **Donor** | Hotel, Restoran, Kafe, Katering | Publikasi surplus pangan, tracking donasi |
| **Penerima** | Panti Asuhan, Rumah Singgah, Lembaga Sosial | Klaim donasi, monitoring gizi |
| **Admin** | Pengelola platform | Verifikasi, approve, monitoring |
| **Publik** | Masyarakat umum | Lihat statistik, top donor |

## 2. Arsitektur Sistem

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   FRONTEND                        │
│         React 19 + Vite + TailwindCSS             │
│         http://localhost:5173                      │
└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                      │ HTTP / JSON / SSE
                      ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   BACKEND API                     │
│        FastAPI + Uvicorn + SQLModel               │
│        http://localhost:3000                       │
└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                      │
                      ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              DATABASE SQLite (.db)                 │
│    10 tabel: users, donations, topsis, dll        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 3. Tech Stack

| Komponen | Teknologi |
|----------|-----------|
| **Runtime** | Python 3.12+ |
| **Framework Backend** | FastAPI 0.139+ |
| **ORM** | SQLModel + SQLAlchemy 2.0 |
| **Database** | SQLite 3 (WAL mode) |
| **Frontend** | React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript 5.8 |
| **CSS** | TailwindCSS v4 |
| **Map** | Leaflet + react-leaflet |
| **Animasi** | Motion (framer-motion) |
| **Auth** | JWT (httpOnly cookie) + bcrypt |
| **Test** | Pytest + httpx + Playwright |

## 4. Struktur Proyek

```
nutrishare/
├── backend/                    # 🐍 Python API
│   ├── main.py                # Entry point, middleware, error handlers
│   ├── config.py              # pydantic-settings
│   ├── database.py            # SQLModel engine, WAL pragma

│   └── tests/                 # Pytest unit + contract + blackbox
│
├── frontend/                   # ⚛️ React SPA
│   ├── src/                   # Pages, components, hooks, contexts

│   └── vite.config.ts         # Vite + proxy config
│
├── tests/                     # Playwright E2E
├── data/                      # SQLite database
├── docs/                      # Documentation + PRD
├── config/                    # Vercel deployment
└── pyproject.toml             # Python dependencies
```

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Ringkasan Eksekutif & Arsitektur

| Metadata | |
|---|---|
| **Versi** | 2.0.0 |
| **Status** | Final |
| **Tanggal** | 2026-07-07 |

## 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif

NUTRI-SHARE adalah platform distribusi surplus pangan yang menghubungkan **donor** (Hotel/Restoran/Kafe) dengan **penerima** (Panti Asuhan/Lembaga Sosial) menggunakan algoritma **Hybrid Entropy-TOPSIS** untuk menentukan prioritas penerima berdasarkan kebutuhan gizi.

### 1.1 Tujuan

1. Mengurangi food waste dengan menyalurkan surplus pangan bergizi
2. Memastikan makanan bernutrisi tinggi sampai ke yang paling membutuhkan
3. Memberikan transparansi penuh dalam proses donasi
4. Mendukung SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) dan SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption)

### 1.2 Target Pengguna

| Segmen | Contoh | Kebutuhan |
|--------|--------|-----------|
| **Donor** | Hotel, Restoran, Kafe, Katering | Publikasi surplus pangan, tracking donasi |
| **Penerima** | Panti Asuhan, Rumah Singgah, Lembaga Sosial | Klaim donasi, monitoring gizi |
| **Admin** | Pengelola platform | Verifikasi, approve, monitoring |
| **Publik** | Masyarakat umum | Lihat statistik, top donor |

## 2. Arsitektur Sistem

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   FRONTEND                        │
│         React 19 + Vite + TailwindCSS             │
│         http://localhost:5173                      │
└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                      │ HTTP / JSON / SSE
                      ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   BACKEND API                     │
│        FastAPI + Uvicorn + SQLModel               │
│        http://localhost:3000                       │
└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                      │
                      ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              DATABASE SQLite (.db)                 │
│    10 tabel: users, donations, topsis, dll        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 3. Tech Stack

| Komponen | Teknologi |
|----------|-----------|
| **Runtime** | Python 3.12+ |
| **Framework Backend** | FastAPI 0.139+ |
| **ORM** | SQLModel + SQLAlchemy 2.0 |
| **Database** | SQLite 3 (WAL mode) |
| **Frontend** | React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript 5.8 |
| **CSS** | TailwindCSS v4 |
| **Map** | Leaflet + react-leaflet |
| **Animasi** | Motion (framer-motion) |
| **Auth** | JWT (httpOnly cookie) + bcrypt |
| **Test** | Pytest + httpx + Playwright |

## 4. Struktur Proyek

```
nutrishare/
├── backend/                    # 🐍 Python API
│   ├── main.py                # Entry point, middleware, error handlers
│   ├── config.py              # pydantic-settings

│

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Auth & Keamanan

## Autentikasi

| Aspek | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Metode** | JWT (HS256) via httpOnly cookie |
| **Nama Cookie** | `nutrishare_token` |
| **Expiry** | 7 hari |
| **Secure** | true di production |
| **SameSite** | Lax |

### Flow Login

```
User → POST /api/auth/login { email, password }
  → bcrypt verify password
  → JWT sign { id, email, role, name, status }
  → Set-Cookie: nutrishare_token=<JWT>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=604800
  → Response { user, profile }
```

## Otorisasi

| Guard | Middleware | Kapan |
|-------|-----------|-------|
| Login | `get_current_user()` | Semua endpoint /api yang butuh auth |
| Role donor | `require_role("donor")` | Buat donasi |
| Role penerima | `require_role("recipient")` | Klaim donasi, history |
| Role admin | `require_role("admin")` | Admin endpoints |

### Cara Kerja

```
Request → Cookie: nutrishare_token=<JWT>
  → JWT decode & verify signature
  → Lookup user by ID dari payload
  → attach user ke request
  → Role check (jika require_role)
  → Next handler
```

## Validasi Input

| Layer | Tool | Contoh |
|-------|------|--------|
| Backend | Pydantic v2 | `RegisterDonorRequest`, `CreateDonationRequest` |
| Frontend | `lib/validation.tsx` | `validateEmail()`, `validateRequired()` |

Pydantic menolak request dengan:
- Field required missing → `422 { "message": "Field required" }`
- Pattern mismatch → `422 { "message": "...pattern..." }`
- Invalid type → `422 { "message": "..." }`

## Keamanan Response Headers

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| X-Content-Type-Options | nosniff |
| X-Frame-Options | DENY |
| Referrer-Policy | strict-origin-when-cross-origin |
| Strict-Transport-Security | max-age=31536000 (hanya production) |

## Rate Limiting & Proteksi

| Proteksi | Status |
|----------|--------|
| Rate limit endpoint | Tidak ada (slowapi dihapus) |
| Per-user login attempt | Tidak ada (seperti Node.js dulu ada) |
| CORS | Origin validation di production |
| SQL Injection | **Aman** — semua via parameter binding |
| XSS | **Aman** — tidak ada rendering HTML dari user |

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — TOPSIS Algorithm

## 5 Kriteria

| Kode | Kriteria | Tipe | Benefit/Cost | Sumber Data |
|------|----------|------|--------------|-------------|
| C1 | Densitas Protein | `min(100, (totalProtein / dailyProteinNeed) * 100)` | Benefit | Donasi × RecipientProfile |
| C2 | Urgensi Kesehatan | `emergency === "active" ? urgency * 1000 : urgency` | Benefit | RecipientProfile |
| C3 | Kelayakan Pangan | `max((validUntil - now) / 3600000, 0.1)` dalam jam | Benefit | Donation.valid_until |
| C4 | Jangkauan Lokasi | Haversine(pickup_lat/lon → recipient_lat/lon) dalam km | Cost | Donation + RecipientProfile |
| C5 | Riwayat Bantuan | `max((now - lastReceived) / 86400000, 0)` dalam hari, default 30 | Benefit | RecipientProfile.last_received_donation |

## Proses Perhitungan

### 1. Normalisasi Vektor

```
norm_factors[j] = sqrt(sum(matrix[i][j]^2))
norm_matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j] / norm_factors[j]
```

### 2. Shannon Entropy — Bobot Objektif

```
p_matrix[i][j] = norm_matrix[i][j] / sum(norm_matrix[][j])
entropy[j] = -k * sum(p_matrix[i][j] * log(p_matrix[i][j]))
  where k = 1/ln(m)
d_j = max(0, 1 - entropy[j])
w_j = d_j / sum(d_j)
```

### 3. Weighted Normalized Matrix

```
v_matrix[i][j] = norm_matrix[i][j] * w_j[j]
```

### 4. Solusi Ideal

```
A_plus[j]  = max(v_matrix[][j]) jika benefit, min jika cost
A_minus[j] = min(v_matrix[][j]) jika benefit, max jika cost
```

### 5. Euclidean Distance

```
D_plus[i]  = sqrt(sum((v_matrix[i][j] - A_plus[j])^2))
D_minus[i] = sqrt(sum((v_matrix[i][j] - A_minus[j])^2))
```

### 6. Closeness Coefficient

```
CI[i] = D_minus[i] / (D_plus[i] + D_minus[i])
```

### 7. Ranking

```
Ranking = sort(CI, descending)
CI tertinggi = Priority #1 → berhak klaim
```

## Edge Cases

| Kasus | Penanganan |
|-------|-----------|
| Protein need = 0 | C1 = 0 |
| Jarak = 0 | C4 = 0 (pinpoint sama) |
| Hanya 1 recipient | Langsung rank 1, CI = 1 (skip entropy) |
| Tidak ada recipient | Return (no ranking) |
| Sum entropy = 0 | Bobot seragam (1/n) |
| Division by zero | Guard dengan EPSILON = 1e-12 |

## Trigger TOPSIS

| Event | Aksi |
|-------|------|
| Donasi baru dipublikasi | `calculate_topsis_for_donation(donation_id)` |
| Admin verifikasi penerima | `run_topsis_all_active()` |
| Admin toggle emergency | `run_topsis_all_active()` |
| Admin klik "Run TOPSIS" | `run_topsis_all_active()` manual |
| Startup server | `run_topsis_all_active()` di lifespan |

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Notifikasi & Gamification

## Notifikasi Real-Time (SSE)

### Metode

Server-Sent Events via `GET /api/notifications/subscribe?user_id=N`

### Cara Kerja

```
Browser → EventSource("/api/notifications/subscribe?user_id=7")
  → Server set header: Content-Type: text/event-stream
  → Server kirim: "data: connected\n\n"
  → Server kirim event setiap ada notifikasi baru
  → 30s keepalive ping: ":ping\n\n"
  → Browser terima → update state React + toast notif
```

### Tipe Notifikasi

| Tipe | Trigger | Penerima | Pesan |
|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `donation_available` | Donasi dipublikasi | Semua penerima verified | "Donasi Tersedia! Donasi {food} sejumlah {n} porsi telah dipublikasikan" |
| `claim_approved` | Admin setujui klaim | Donor + penerima terkait | "Klaim Disetujui! Donasi {food} telah disetujui" |
| `verification` | Admin verifikasi user | User terverifikasi | "Akun Anda telah diverifikasi" |
| `system` | Klaim baru | Admin | "Klaim Baru! Donasi {food} diklaim oleh {institution}" |

### Polling Fallback

Frontend juga polling `GET /api/notifications?user_id=N` setiap 30 detik sebagai fallback jika SSE gagal.

## Gamification

### Badges Donor

| Badge | Syarat | Icon |
|-------|--------|------|
| Donator Pemula | ≥ 1 donasi | 🌱 |
| Donator Aktif | ≥ 5 donasi | ⭐ |
| Pahlawan Pangan | ≥ 10 donasi | 🏆 |
| Legenda Donasi | ≥ 20 donasi | 👑 |
| Favorit Penerima | ≥ 5 ulasan positif | ❤️ |

### Perhitungan Badges

```python
def calculate_badges(total_donations: int, review_count: int) -> list[dict]:
    badges = []
    if total_donations >= 1:  badges.append({"name": "Donator Pemula", ...})
    if total_donations >= 5:  badges.append({"name": "Donator Aktif", ...})
    if total_donations >= 10: badges.append({"name": "Pahlawan Pangan", ...})
    if total_donations >= 20: badges.append({"name": "Legenda Donasi", ...})
    if review_count >= 5:     badges.append({"name": "Favorit Penerima", ...})
    return badges
```

### Top Donors

3 besar donor ditampilkan di halaman **Pahlawan** (`/pahlawan`)

```
SELECT * FROM donor_profiles ORDER BY total_donations DESC LIMIT 3
```

Setiap donor menampilkan:
- Nama bisnis
- Jumlah donasi
- Rating rata-rata (dari reviews)
- Jumlah ulasan
- Logo (jika ada)

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Flow Bisnis & Status

## Flow Donasi Lengkap

```
DONOR                          SISTEM                      PENERIMA
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Register                    │                            ├─ Register
  ├─ Diverifikasi admin          │                            ├─ Diverifikasi admin
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Login                       │                            ├─ Login
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Buat Donasi ───────────────►│                            │
  │    • nama makanan            │                            │
  │    • porsi, protein, kalori  ├── TOPSIS Ranking           │
  │    • lokasi pickup           │    • C1-C5 + Entropy       │
  │    • masa berlaku            │    • CI Score              │
  │                              │    • Rank #1, #2, #3...    │
  │                              │    • Notif ke penerima     │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄────────── Lihat Aktif ────┤
  │                              │    • TOPSIS rank           │
  │                              │    • CI score              │
  │                              │    • Jarak, urgensi        │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄─────────── Klaim ─────────┤
  │                              │    • Priority #1           │
  │                              │    • Notif admin           │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄── Admin Approve ──────────┤
  │                              │    • Status → claimed      │
  │                              │    • Notif donor+penerima  │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄── Konfirmasi Sampai ──────┤
  │                              │    • arrived_at diisi      │
  │                              │    • Notif donor           │
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Konfirmasi Selesai ────────►│                            │
  │    • Status → completed      │                            │
  │    • Donasi +1               │                            │
  │    • Badge update            │                            │
  │                              │                            │
  │◄────────── Lihat Ulasan ─────┤◄─────────── Review ────────┤
  │    • Rating & komentar       │    • Rating 1-5            │
  │    • Badge "Favorit"         │    • Komentar               │
```

## Status Donasi

```
                    ┌──────────┐
                    │  active  │  ← Donasi dipublikasi
                    └────┬─────┘
                         │ Penerima klaim (priority #1)
                         ▼
                    ┌──────────┐
                    │  claimed  │  ← Admin approve
                    └────┬─────┘
                         │ Kurir antar
                         ▼
                    ┌──────────┐
                    │  arrived  │  ← (field arrived_at, bukan status)
                    └────┬─────┘
                         │ Donor konfirmasi selesai
                         ▼
                    ┌───────────┐
                    │ completed  │  ← Selesai!
                    └───────────┘

         active ──► expired (jika lewat valid_until)
```

## Status User

```
┌─────────┐
│ pending │  ← Baru daftar, menunggu admin
└────┬────┘
     │ Admin verifikasi
     ▼
┌──────────┐
│ verified  │  ← Bisa login & pakai fitur
└──────────┘

┌──────────┐
│ rejected  │  ← Ditolak admin
└──────────┘
```

## Emergency Status (Penerima)

```
none ──► pending ──► active ──► none
  │         │            │
  │         ▼            │
  └── (toggle)           │
       Penerima         └── (admin toggle)
       minta bantuan        Selesai darurat
```

## AKG Gizi Harian

Perhitungan di endpoint `GET /api/recipient/akg?user_id=7`

```
1. Cari semua donations completed hari ini untuk user
2. Total protein = sum(protein_per_portion * portion_count)
3. Total kalori  = sum(calorie_per_portion * portion_count)
4. Total zat besi = sum(iron_mg * portion_count)
5. Total vitamin C = sum(vitamin_c_mg * portion_count)
6. Persentase:
   protein_pct = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
   kalori_pct  = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
   fe_pct      = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
   vitc_pct    = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
7. Overall = rata-rata 4 persentase
```

D_minus[i] = sqrt(sum((v_matrix[i][j] - A_minus[j])^2))
```

### 6. Closeness Coefficient

```
CI[i] = D_minus[i] / (D_plus[i] + D_minus[i])
```

### 7. Ranking

```
Ranking = sort(CI, descending)
CI tertinggi = Priority #1 → berhak klaim
```

## Edge Cases

| Kasus | Penanganan |
|-------|-----------|
| Protein need = 0 | C1 = 0 |
| Jarak = 0 | C4 = 0 (pinpoint sama) |
| Hanya 1 recipient | Langsung rank 1, CI = 1 (skip entropy) |
| Tidak ada recipient | Return (no ranking) |
| Sum entropy = 0 | Bobot seragam (1/n) |
| Division by zero | Guard dengan EPSILON = 1e-12 |

## Trigger TOPSIS

| Event | Aksi |
|-------|------|
| Donasi baru dipublikasi | `calculate_topsis_for_donation(donation_id)` |
| Admin verifikasi penerima | `run_topsis_all_active()` |
| Admin toggle emergency | `run_topsis_all_active()` |
| Admin klik "Run TOPSIS" | `run_topsis_all_active()` manual |
| Startup server | `run_topsis_all_active()` di lifespan |

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Notifikasi & Gamification

## Notifikasi Real-Time (SSE)

### Metode

Server-Sent Events via `GET /api/notifications/subscribe?user_id=N`

### Cara Kerja

```
Browser → EventSource("/api/notifications/subscribe?user_id=7")
  → Server set header: Content-Type: text/event-stream
  → Server kirim: "data: connected\n\n"
  → Server kirim event setiap ada notifikasi baru
  → 30s keepalive ping: ":ping\n\n"
  → Browser terima → update state React + toast notif
```

### Tipe Notifikasi

| Tipe | Trigger | Penerima | Pesan |
|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `donation_available` | Donasi dipublikasi | Semua penerima verified | "Donasi Tersedia! Donasi {food} sejumlah {n} porsi telah dipublikasikan" |
| `claim_approved` | Admin setujui klaim | Donor + penerima terkait | "Klaim Disetujui! Donasi {food} telah disetujui" |
| `verification` | Admin verifikasi user | User terverifikasi | "Akun Anda telah diverifikasi" |
| `system` | Klaim baru | Admin | "Klaim Baru! Donasi {food} diklaim oleh {institution}" |

### Polling Fallback

Frontend juga polling `GET /api/notifications?user_id=N` setiap 30 detik sebagai fallback jika SSE gagal.

## Gamification

### Badges Donor

| Badge | Syarat | Icon |
|-------|--------|------|
| Donator Pemula | ≥ 1 donasi | 🌱 |
| Donator Aktif | ≥ 5 donasi | ⭐ |
| Pahlawan Pangan | ≥ 10 donasi | 🏆 |
| Legenda Donasi | ≥ 20 donasi | 👑 |
| Favorit Penerima | ≥ 5 ulasan positif | ❤️ |

### Perhitungan Badges

```python
def calculate_badges(total_donations: int, review_count: int) -> list[dict]:
    badges = []
    if total_donations >= 1:  badges.append({"name": "Donator Pemula", ...})
    if total_donations >= 5:  badges.append({"name": "Donator Aktif", ...})
    if total_donations >= 10: badges.append({"name": "Pahlawan Pangan", ...})
    if total_donations >= 20: badges.append({"name": "Legenda Donasi", ...})
    if review_count >= 5:     badges.append({"name": "Favorit Penerima", ...})
    return badges
```

### Top Donors

3 besar donor ditampilkan di halaman **Pahlawan** (`/pahlawan`)

```
SELECT * FROM donor_profiles ORDER BY total_donations DESC LIMIT 3
```

Setiap donor menampilkan:
- Nama bisnis
- Jumlah donasi
- Rating rata-rata (dari reviews)
- Jumlah ulasan
- Logo (jika ada)

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Flow Bisnis & Status

## Flow Donasi Lengkap

```
DONOR                          SISTEM                      PENERIMA
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Register                    │                            ├─ Register
  ├─ Diverifikasi admin          │                            ├─ Diverifikasi admin
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Login                       │                            ├─ Login
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Buat Donasi ───────────────►│                            │
  │    • nama makanan            │                            │
  │    • porsi, protein, kalori  ├── TOPSIS Ranking           │
  │    • lokasi pickup           │    • C1-C5 + Entropy       │
  │    • masa berlaku            │    • CI Score              │
  │                              │    • Rank #1, #2, #3...    │
  │                              │    • Notif ke penerima     │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄────────── Lihat Aktif ────┤
  │                              │    • TOPSIS rank           │
  │                              │    • CI score              │
  │                              │    • Jarak, urgensi        │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄─────────── Klaim ─────────┤
  │                              │    • Priority #1           │
  │                              │    • Notif admin           │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄── Admin Approve ──────────┤
  │                              │    • Status → claimed      │
  │                              │    • Notif donor+penerima  │
  │                              │                            │
  │                              │◄── Konfirmasi Sampai ──────┤
  │                              │    • arrived_at diisi      │
  │                              │    • Notif donor           │
  │                              │                            │
  ├─ Konfirmasi Selesai ────────►│                            │
  │    • Status → completed      │                            │
  │    • Donasi +1               │                            │
  │    • Badge update            │                            │
  │                              │                            │
  │◄────────── Lihat Ulasan ─────┤◄─────────── Review ────────┤
  │    • Rating & komentar       │    • Rating 1-5            │
  │    • Badge "Favorit"         │    • Komentar               │
```

## Status Donasi

```
                    ┌──────────┐
                    │  active  │  ← Donasi dipublikasi
                    └────┬─────┘
                         │ Penerima klaim (priority #1)
                         ▼
                    ┌──────────┐
                    │  claimed  │  ← Admin approve
                    └────┬─────┘
                         │ Kurir antar
                         ▼
                    ┌──────────┐
                    │  arrived  │  ← (field arrived_at, bukan status)
                    └────┬─────┘
                         │ Donor konfirmasi selesai
                         ▼
                    ┌───────────┐
                    │ completed  │  ← Selesai!
                    └───────────┘

         active ──► expired (jika lewat valid_until)
```

## Status User

```
┌─────────┐
│ pending │  ← Baru daftar, menunggu admin
└────┬────┘
     │ Admin verifikasi
     ▼
┌──────────┐
│ verified  │  ← Bisa login & pakai fitur
└──────────┘

┌──────────┐
│ rejected  │  ← Ditolak admin
└──────────┘
```

## Emergency Status (Penerima)

```
none ──► pending ──► active ──► none
  │         │            │
  │         ▼            │
  └── (toggle)           │
       Penerima         └── (admin toggle)
       minta bantuan        Selesai darurat
```

## AKG Gizi Harian

Perhitungan di endpoint `GET /api/recipient/akg?user_id=7`

```
1. Cari semua donations completed hari ini untuk user
2. Total protein = sum(protein_per_portion * portion_count)
3. Total kalori  = sum(calorie_per_portion * portion_count)
4. Total zat besi = sum(iron_mg * portion_count)
5. Total vitamin C = sum(vitamin_c_mg * portion_count)
6. Persentase:
   protein_pct = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
   kalori_pct  = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
   fe_pct      = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
   vitc_pct    = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
7. Overall = rata-rata 4 persentase
```

Jika data sudah besar, migrasi dari SQLite ke PostgreSQL perlu dipersiapkan.

### File Storage
Upload foto saat ini di filesystem lokal. Untuk production, perlu object storage (S3/MinIO).

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Ringkasan Eksekutif & Arsitektur

**Versi:** 2.0.0 | **Status:** Final | **Tanggal:** 2026-07-07

---

## 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif

NUTRI-SHARE adalah platform distribusi surplus pangan yang menghubungkan **donor** (Hotel/Restoran/Kafe) dengan **penerima** (Panti Asuhan/Lembaga Sosial) menggunakan algoritma **Hybrid Entropy-TOPSIS** untuk menentukan prioritas penerima berdasarkan kebutuhan gizi.

Platform ini lahir dari keprihatinan terhadap paradoks pangan Indonesia: 23-48 juta ton food loss and waste per tahun dengan kerugian Rp213-551 triliun (BAPPENAS 2021), sementara masih banyak kelompok rentan mengalami kekurangan gizi (hidden hunger).

### 1.1 Tujuan

| # | Tujuan | Dampak |
|---|--------|--------|
| 1 | Mengurangi food waste dengan menyalurkan surplus pangan bergizi | Lingkungan lebih baik, pengurangan emisi metana |
| 2 | Memastikan makanan bernutrisi tinggi sampai ke yang paling membutuhkan | Perbaikan gizi kelompok rentan |
| 3 | Menggunakan algoritma objektif (bukan first-come-first-served) | Distribusi adil dan tepat sasaran |
| 4 | Memberikan transparansi penuh dalam proses donasi | Kepercayaan semua pihak |
| 5 | Mendukung SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) dan SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption) | Kontribusi global |

### 1.2 Target Pengguna

| Segmen | Contoh | Kebutuhan Utama | Jumlah Route |

**Versi:** 2.0.0 | **Status:** Final | **Tanggal:** 2026-07-07

## 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif

NUTRI-SHARE adalah platform distribusi surplus pangan yang menghubungkan **donor** (Hotel/Restoran/Kafe) dengan **penerima** (Panti Asuhan/Lembaga Sosial) menggunakan algoritma **Hybrid Entropy-TOPSIS** untuk menentukan prioritas penerima berdasarkan kebutuhan gizi.

Platform ini lahir dari keprihatinan terhadap paradoks pangan Indonesia: 23-48 juta ton food loss and waste per tahun dengan kerugian Rp213-551 triliun (BAPPENAS 2021), sementara masih banyak kelompok rentan mengalami kekurangan gizi (hidden hunger).

### 1.1 Tujuan

| # | Tujuan | Dampak |
|---|--------|--------|
| 1 | Mengurangi food waste dengan menyalurkan surplus pangan bergizi | Lingkungan lebih baik, pengurangan emisi metana |
| 2 | Memastikan makanan bernutrisi tinggi sampai ke yang paling membutuhkan | Perbaikan gizi kelompok rentan |
| 3 | Menggunakan algoritma objektif (bukan first-come-first-served) | Distribusi adil dan tepat sasaran |
| 4 | Memberikan transparansi penuh dalam proses donasi | Kepercayaan semua pihak |
| 5 | Mendukung SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) dan SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption) | Kontribusi global |

  │                                │◄── INSERT notification ───────┤
  │                                ├──► sse_manager.notify_user()
  │                                ├──► queue.put("data: {...}")
  │◄── "data: {notification}" ────┤                                │
  │                                │                                │
  │    (30 detik tanpa event)     │                                │
  │◄── ":ping\n\n" ───────────────┤                                │
```

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Ringkasan Eksekutif & Arsitektur

| Metadata | |
|---|---|
| **Versi** | 2.0.0 |
| **Status** | Final |
| **Tanggal** | 2026-07-07 |

## 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif

NUTRI-SHARE adalah platform distribusi surplus pangan yang menghubungkan **donor** (Hotel/Restoran/Kafe) dengan **penerima** (Panti Asuhan/Lembaga Sosial) menggunakan algoritma **Hybrid Entropy-TOPSIS** untuk menentukan prioritas penerima berdasarkan kebutuhan gizi.

### 1.1 Tujuan

1. Mengurangi food waste dengan menyalurkan surplus pangan bergizi
2. Memastikan makanan bernutrisi tinggi sampai ke yang paling membutuhkan
3. Memberikan transparansi penuh dalam proses donasi
4. Mendukung SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) dan SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption)

### 1.2 Target Pengguna

| Segmen | Contoh | Kebutuhan |
|--------|--------|-----------|
| **Donor** | Hotel, Restoran, Kafe, Katering | Publikasi surplus pangan, tracking donasi |
| **Penerima** | Panti Asuhan, Rumah Singgah, Lembaga Sosial | Klaim donasi, monitoring gizi |
| **Admin** | Pengelola platform | Verifikasi, approve, monitoring |
| **Publik** | Masyarakat umum | Lihat statistik, top donor |

## 2. Arsitektur Sistem

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   FRONTEND                        │
│         React 19 + Vite + TailwindCSS             │
│         http://localhost:5173                      │
└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                      │ HTTP / JSON / SSE
                      ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   BACKEND API                     │
│        FastAPI + Uvicorn + SQLModel               │
│        http://localhost:3000                       │
└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                      │
                      ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              DATABASE SQLite (.db)                 │
│    10 tabel: users, donations, topsis, dll        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 3. Tech Stack

| Komponen | Teknologi |
|----------|-----------|
| **Runtime** | Python 3.12+ |
| **Framework Backend** | FastAPI 0.139+ |
| **ORM** | SQLModel + SQLAlchemy 2.0 |
| **Database** | SQLite 3 (WAL mode) |
| **Frontend** | React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript 5.8 |
| **CSS** | TailwindCSS v4 |
| **Map** | Leaflet + react-leaflet |
| **Animasi** | Motion (framer-motion) |
| **Auth** | JWT (httpOnly cookie) + bcrypt |

## Tabel 1: users

Tabel utama untuk semua pengguna (donor, penerima, admin).

| # | Field | Type | Constraints | Default | Deskripsi |

| 1 | id | INTEGER | PK AUTOINCREMENT | | Primary key |
| 2 | name | TEXT | NOT NULL | | Nama lengkap pengguna |
| 3 | email | TEXT | NOT NULL UNIQUE | | Email login |
| 4 | password | TEXT | NOT NULL | | bcrypt hash (60+ chars) |
| 5 | role | TEXT | NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('donor','recipient','admin')) | | Role pengguna |
| 6 | status | TEXT | NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','verified','rejected')) | 'pending' | Status verifikasi |
| 7 | reset_token | TEXT | NULLABLE | NULL | Token reset password (32 char random) |
| 8 | reset_token_expiry | TEXT | NULLABLE | NULL | ISO timestamp kadaluarsa token |

**Index:** UNIQUE(email)

**Foreign Keys:** none

**Sample Data:**
```json
{ "id": 1, "name": "Admin", "email": "admin@test.com", "password": "$2b$12$...", "role": "admin", "status": "verified" }

| 9 | raw_c5 | REAL | NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 | 0 | Nilai mentah kriteria 5 (riwayat) |

**Relasi:** Donation(1) → TopsisResults(N), Recipient(1) → TopsisResults(N)

| 8 | created_at | TEXT | NOT NULL | | ISO timestamp dibuat |

---

## Tabel 7: claims

Riwayat klaim donasi oleh penerima.

| # | Field | Type | Constraints | Default | Deskripsi |
|---|-------|------|------------|---------|-----------|

| 2 | donation_id | INTEGER | NOT NULL REFERENCES donations(id) | | Donasi yang diklaim |

## Tabel 8: reviews

| 6 | comment | TEXT | NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | '' | Komentar ulasan |

---

## Tabel 9: activity_logs

Log aktivitas untuk audit trail.

users
  │

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Modul Backend (42 Endpoint)

**Framework:** FastAPI 0.139 | **Validator:** Pydantic v2 | **Total Router Files:** 10

---

## 5.1 Auth — 9 Endpoint (routers/auth.py)

### POST /api/auth/register/donor
Daftar akun donor baru.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "business_name": "Hotel Aston",
  "email": "aston@hotel.com",
  "password": "rahasia123",
  "business_type": "hotel",
  "address": "Jl. Malioboro No. 1, Yogyakarta",
  "latitude": "-7.7956",
  "longitude": "110.3695",
  "phone": "08123456789"
}
```
**Response:** `{ "message": "Berhasil daftar. Menunggu verifikasi admin." }`
**Status:** 200 | **Error:** 409 (email duplikat)
**Logic:** hash password → INSERT user (role=donor, status=pending) → INSERT donor_profiles

+**Sort:** rank ascending (999 jika tidak punya rank)
+**Logic:** Jika role=recipient → filter by claimed_by. Jika role=donor → filter by donor_id.
+**Logic:** Cari claims WHERE recipient_id=current_user AND status='approved'
+**Logic:** Cek TOPSIS rank → INSERT claim (status=pending) → notif admin → activity log
+**Logic:** UPDATE status='completed', completed_at, total_donations++, last_received_donation → activity log
+**Logic:** Sum semua donation completed hari ini untuk user → bandingkan dengan daily_need
+**Error:** 400 jika emergency active (harus admin yang toggle)
+**Logic:** INSERT review → notif donor → activity log
+Jalankan ulang TOPSIS untuk semua donasi aktif.
+**Logic:** UPDATE status='verified', set urgency_score (opsional) → TOPSIS rerun jika recipient
+**Logic:** UPDATE claim → UPDATE donation status='claimed' → notif donor+penerima via SSE → activity log
+**Logic:** Transaksi DELETE cascade manual — claims, topsis, reviews, notif, donations, profiles, logs, user

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "";  // empty = same origin (Vite proxy)

async function fetchJSON(url: string, options?: RequestInit) {

  const res = await fetch(fullUrl, { ...options, credentials: "include" });

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Auth & Keamanan

---

## 7.1 Autentikasi (JWT + httpOnly Cookie)

### 7.1.1 Flow Login

```
User → input email + password → klik "Masuk"
  │
  ▼
POST /api/auth/login { email, password }
  │
  ▼
SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?
  │
  ├── Tidak ditemukan → 401 "Kredensial tidak valid"
  │
  ▼
bcrypt.checkpw(password, user.password)
  │
  ├── Salah → 401 "Kredensial tidak valid"
  │
  ▼
Cek user.status
  │
  ├── pending/verified → 403 "Akun Anda belum diverifikasi admin." (kecuali admin)
  │
  ▼
JWT.sign({ id, email, role, name, status }, JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: "7d" })
  │
  ▼
response.set_cookie("nutrishare_token", jwt, {
  httponly: true,
  secure: ENVIRONMENT === "production",
  samesite: "lax",
  maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60,  // 7 hari dalam detik
  path: "/"
})
  │
  ▼
Response { user: { id, name, email, role, status }, profile: { ... } }
```

### 7.1.2 JWT Payload

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "email": "admin@test.com",
  "role": "admin",
  "name": "Admin Test",
  "status": "verified",
  "exp": 1783926909
}
```

**Algoritma:** HS256 (HMAC with SHA-256)
**Secret:** `JWT_SECRET` env var (default: "dev-secret-change-in-production")
**Warning:** HMAC key < 32 bytes menghasilkan `InsecureKeyLengthWarning` — direkomendasikan ≥ 32 chars

### 7.1.3 Verifikasi Cookie

```
Request → Header Cookie: nutrishare_token=<JWT>
  │
  ▼
get_current_user() dependency:
  │
  ├── Tidak ada cookie → raise 401 "Belum login"
  │
  ▼
jwt.decode(token, JWT_SECRET, algorithms=["HS256"])
  │
  ├── Invalid/expired → clear cookie + raise 401 "Sesi tidak valid"
  │
  ▼
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = payload.id
  │
  ├── Tidak ditemukan → clear cookie + raise 401 "User tidak ditemukan"
  │
  ▼
return user (ke endpoint handler)
```

### 7.1.4 Cookie Config

| Parameter | Development | Production |
|-----------|------------|------------|
| Name | `nutrishare_token` | `nutrishare_token` |
| HttpOnly | ✅ | ✅ |
| Secure | ❌ | ✅ |
| SameSite | Lax | Lax |
| MaxAge | 604800s (7 hari) | 604800s (7 hari) |
| Path | `/` | `/` |

---

## 7.2 Otorisasi (Role Guards)

### `get_current_user()` — Check login
Semua endpoint dengan `Depends(get_current_user)` — butuh JWT valid di cookie.

### `require_role("donor")` — Check role donor
```python
async def _role_checker(current_user = Depends(get_current_user)):
    if current_user.role not in ("donor",):
        raise 403 "Tidak punya akses"
```

### `require_role("recipient")` — Check role penerima
Guard untuk: klaim donasi, lihat history.

### `require_role("admin")` — Check role admin
Guard untuk: semua /api/admin/*, verify, approve, delete.

### Ringkasan Role Access

| Endpoint | Role |
|----------|------|
| POST /api/donations | donor |
| POST /api/donations/{id}/claim | recipient |
| POST /api/donations/{id}/arrived | recipient |
| POST /api/donations/{id}/complete | donor |
| GET /api/donations/history | recipient |
| ALL /api/admin/* | admin |
| ALL /api/auth/* | public (except admin register) |
| GET /api/dashboard/* | public |
| Semua GET publik | public |

---

## 7.3 Validasi Input (Pydantic v2)

### 7.3.1 Schema List

| Schema | Fields | Validasi Khusus |
|--------|--------|-----------------|
| LoginRequest | email, password | min length 1 |
| RegisterDonorRequest | 10 fields | password min 6, business_type enum, lat/lng |
| RegisterRecipientRequest | 17 fields | password min 6, institution_type enum |
| RegisterAdminRequest | 4 fields | admin_key required |
| CreateDonationRequest | 13 fields | food_type enum, numeric regex |
| AdminVerifyRequest | urgency_score | optional |
| ReviewRequest | 5 fields | rating 1-5 |
| EmergencyRequest | user_id | int positive |
| ForgotPasswordRequest | email | valid email |
| ResetPasswordRequest | 2 fields | password min 6 |
| UpdateProfileRequest | 17 fields | semua optional |

### 7.3.2 Error Format

Validation error → `422 { "message": "Field required" }`
(dihandle oleh `validation_exception_handler` — bukan default FastAPI `{"detail": [...]}`)

### 7.3.3 Frontend Validation

File: `lib/validation.tsx`

| Function | Rule |
|----------|------|
| `validateEmail(email)` | Required + regex `/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/` |
| `validatePassword(password)` | Required + min 6 chars |
| `validateRequired(value, fieldName)` | Required + trim check |
| `validateNumber(value, fieldName)` | Required + isNaN + > 0 |

Frontend validasi real-time via `onBlur` + on submit.

---

## 7.4 Security Headers

| Header | Value | Middleware |
|--------|-------|-----------|
| X-Content-Type-Options | `nosniff` | `add_security_headers` |
| X-Frame-Options | `DENY` | `add_security_headers` |
| Referrer-Policy | `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` | `add_security_headers` |
| Strict-Transport-Security | `max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload` | `add_security_headers` (production only) |

---

## 7.5 CORS

```python
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=settings.cors_origins if settings.is_production else ["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)
```

Production: hanya origin di `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` env var (default: localhost:3000, localhost:5173)
Development: allow all origins (CORS longgar untuk dev)

---

## 7.6 Error Handling

| Exception Handler | Status | Format |
|------------------|--------|--------|
| `StarletteHTTPException` | 404 | `{ "message": "Endpoint tidak ditemukan" }` |
| `HTTPException` | Variabel | `{ "message": exc.detail }` |
| `RequestValidationError` | 422 | `{ "message": "Field required" }` |
| `Exception` (catch-all) | 500 | `{ "message": "Terjadi kesalahan server" }` |

---

## 7.7 Proteksi Keamanan

| Ancaman | Status | Mekanisme |
|---------|--------|-----------|
| SQL Injection | ✅ **Aman** | Semua query via SQLModel parameter binding (`:param`), bukan string concatenation |
| XSS | ✅ **Aman** | React auto-escape, tidak ada `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, tidak ada rendering HTML dari user |
| CSRF | ✅ **Aman** | httpOnly cookie + SameSite=Lax — script pihak ketiga tidak bisa baca cookie |
| Hardcoded Secret | ⚠️ Default | Dev defaults di code, production strict check startup |
| Sensitive Data Leak | ✅ **Aman** | Password tidak pernah di-response (hanya `SELECT ...` tanpa field password) |
| Path Traversal | ✅ **Aman** | Filename upload di-sanitize: `re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]", "_", name)` |
| Auth Bypass | ✅ **Aman** | Setiap endpoint protected punya guard `Depends(get_current_user)` |
| CORS | ✅ **Aman** | Origin validation di production |

---

## 7.8 Konfigurasi Production

App akan **gagal startup** di production jika:
- `JWT_SECRET` masih default
- `ADMIN_SECRET_KEY` masih default

```python
def validate_production():
    if jwt_secret == "dev-secret-change-in-production":
        raise ValueError("JWT_SECRET is required in production")
    if admin_secret_key == "admin-secret-change-me":
        raise ValueError("ADMIN_SECRET_KEY is required in production")
```

| **Nama Cookie** | `nutrishare_token` |
| **Expiry** | 7 hari |
| **Secure** | true di production |
| **SameSite** | Lax |

### Flow Login

```
User → POST /api/auth/login { email, password }
  → bcrypt verify password
  → JWT sign { id, email, role, name, status }
  → Set-Cookie: nutrishare_token=<JWT>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=604800
  → Response { user, profile }
```

## Otorisasi

| Guard | Middleware | Kapan |
|-------|-----------|-------|
| Login | `get_current_user()` | Semua endpoint /api yang butuh auth |
| Role donor | `require_role("donor")` | Buat donasi |
| Role penerima | `require_role("recipient")` | Klaim donasi, history |
| Role admin | `require_role("admin")` | Admin endpoints |

### Cara Kerja

```
Request → Cookie: nutrishare_token=<JWT>
  → JWT decode & verify signature
  → Lookup user by ID dari payload
  → attach user ke request
  → Role check (jika require_role)
  → Next handler
```

| Layer | Tool | Contoh |
|-------|------|--------|
| Backend | Pydantic v2 | `RegisterDonorRequest`, `CreateDonationRequest` |

- Pattern mismatch → `422 { "message": "...pattern..." }`
- Invalid type → `422 { "message": "..." }`

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| X-Content-Type-Options | nosniff |
| X-Frame-Options | DENY |
| Referrer-Policy | strict-origin-when-cross-origin |
| Strict-Transport-Security | max-age=31536000 (hanya production) |

| Proteksi | Status |
|----------|--------|
| Rate limit endpoint | Tidak ada (slowapi dihapus) |
| Per-user login attempt | Tidak ada (seperti Node.js dulu ada) |
| CORS | Origin validation di production |

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — TOPSIS Algorithm

**Metode:** Hybrid Entropy-TOPSIS | **Library:** NumPy (vectorized) | **File:** `backend/services/topsis.py`

---

## 8.1 5 Kriteria

TOPSIS menggunakan 5 kriteria (C1-C5) untuk menentukan prioritas penerima:

| Kriteria | Rumus | Benefit/Cost | Deskripsi |
|----------|-------|--------------|-----------|
| **C1 — Densitas Protein** | `min(100, totalProtein / dailyProteinNeed * 100)` | Benefit (max) | Semakin tinggi % kebutuhan protein terpenuhi → semakin baik |
| **C2 — Urgensi Kesehatan** | `emergency == "active" ? urgency * 1000 : urgency` | Benefit (max) | Semakin tinggi urgency score → semakin prioritas. Emergency * 1000 boost |
| **C3 — Kelayakan Pangan** | `max((validUntil - now) / 3600000, 0.1)` dalam jam | Benefit (max) | Semakin lama masa berlaku → semakin fleksibel |
| **C4 — Jangkauan Lokasi** | `haversine(pickupLat, pickupLon, recipLat, recipLon)` dalam km | Cost (min) | Semakin dekat jarak → semakin baik (cost) |
| **C5 — Riwayat Bantuan** | `max((now - lastReceived) / 86400000, 0)` atau 30 jika null | Benefit (max) | Semakin lama sejak terakhir terima → semakin prioritas |

### 8.1.1 Detail C1 — Densitas Protein

```python
totalProtein = donation.protein_per_portion * donation.portion_count
c1 = min(100, (totalProtein / rp.daily_protein_need) * 100) if rp.daily_protein_need > 0 else 0
```

Mengukur seberapa besar donasi ini memenuhi kebutuhan protein harian penerima. Capped di 100% untuk mencegah bias.

### 8.1.2 Detail C2 — Urgensi Kesehatan

```python
c2 = rp.urgency_score * 1000 if rp.emergency == "active" else rp.urgency_score
```

Skor urgensi (1-5) dari admin. Jika status darurat active, nilai dikalikan 1000 untuk prioritas absolut.

### 8.1.3 Detail C3 — Kelayakan Pangan

```python
diff_hours = max((valid_until_ms - now_ms) / HOUR_MS, 0.1)
c3 = diff_hours
```

Sisa waktu dalam jam sebelum makanan kedaluwarsa. Minimal 0.1 jam untuk mencegah division by zero.

### 8.1.4 Detail C4 — Jangkauan Lokasi

```python
def haversine_km(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # radius bumi dalam km
    dlat = radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlon = radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = sin(dlat/2)^2 + cos(radians(lat1)) * cos(radians(lat2)) * sin(dlon/2)^2
    return R * 2 * atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1-a))
```

Satu-satunya kriteria **cost** — semakin kecil semakin baik karena jarak dekat lebih efisien.

### 8.1.5 Detail C5 — Riwayat Bantuan

```python
c5 = 30.0  # default 30 hari
if rp.last_received_donation:
    days_since = (now_ms - last_ms) / DAY_MS
    c5 = max(days_since, 0)
```

Default 30 hari untuk penerima yang belum pernah menerima donasi. Benefit — semakin lama tidak terima, semakin prioritas.

---

## 8.2 Algoritma Hybrid Entropy-TOPSIS

### Step 1: Build Decision Matrix

```
Matrix X (m x n) dimana:
  m = jumlah penerima verified
  n = 5 (jumlah kriteria)

X[i][j] = nilai kriteria j untuk penerima i
```

### Step 2: Normalisasi Vektor

```python
norm_factors[j] = sqrt(SUM(X[i][j]^2))  # panjang vektor tiap kolom
norm_factors = max(norm_factors, EPSILON)  # guard division by zero
R[i][j] = X[i][j] / norm_factors[j]        # normalized matrix
```

### Step 3: Shannon Entropy — Bobot Objektif

```python
# Hitung p_matrix (proporsi)
p_sum[j] = SUM(R[i][j])
p_sum = max(p_sum, EPSILON)
P[i][j] = R[i][j] / p_sum[j]

# Entropy tiap kriteria
k = -1.0 / ln(m)                   # konstanta entropy
E[j] = -k * SUM(P[i][j] * ln(P[i][j]))  # entropy

# Divergence
d[j] = max(0, 1 - E[j])

# Bobot final
if SUM(d) == 0:
    w[j] = 1/n  # uniform weight
else:
    w[j] = d[j] / SUM(d)
```

**Keunggulan:** Bobot dihitung secara objektif dari data, bukan subjektif dari admin.

### Step 4: Weighted Normalized Matrix

```python
V[i][j] = R[i][j] * w[j]
```

### Step 5: Solusi Ideal

```python
A_plus[j]  = max(V[:][j])  jika benefit, min(V[:][j])  jika cost
A_minus[j] = min(V[:][j])  jika benefit, max(V[:][j])  jika cost
```

### Step 6: Euclidean Distance

```python
D_plus[i]  = sqrt(SUM((V[i][j] - A_plus[j])^2))
D_minus[i] = sqrt(SUM((V[i][j] - A_minus[j])^2))
```

### Step 7: Closeness Coefficient

```python
if D_plus[i] + D_minus[i] == 0:
    CI[i] = 0
else:
    CI[i] = D_minus[i] / (D_plus[i] + D_minus[i])
```

### Step 8: Ranking

```python
sorted_indices = argsort(-CI)  # descending
rank_position = index + 1
```

Rank 1 = prioritas tertinggi = berhak klaim pertama.

---

## 8.3 Edge Cases

| Kasus | Penanganan |
|-------|-----------|
| **Tidak ada penerima verified** | Return, tidak ada ranking |
| **Hanya 1 penerima** | Rank 1, CI=1, D+=0, D-=1 tanpa entropy |
| **Daily protein need = 0** | C1 = 0 |
| **Semua nilai sama** | Bobot entropy uniform (1/n) |
| **Division by zero** | Guard dengan EPSILON = 1e-12 |
| **Last received donation null** | C5 = 30 hari (default) |
| **Valid until sudah lewat** | C3 = 0.1 jam (min) |

---

## 8.4 Trigger TOPSIS

| Event | Aksi | Scope |
|-------|------|-------|
| Donasi baru dipublikasi | `calculate_topsis_for_donation(donation_id)` | Satu donasi |
| Admin verifikasi penerima | `run_topsis_all_active()` | Semua donasi aktif |
| Admin toggle emergency | `run_topsis_all_active()` | Semua donasi aktif |
| Admin klik "Run TOPSIS" | `run_topsis_all_active()` | Semua donasi aktif |
| Server startup | `run_topsis_all_active()` di lifespan | Semua donasi aktif |

### 8.4.1 Notifikasi Priority

Saat TOPSIS selesai, penerima rank #1 mendapat notifikasi khusus:

```sql
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, title, message, type, related_donation_id)
VALUES (recipient_id, 'Donasi Prioritas!', 'Anda prioritas utama: {food_name}', 'donation_available', donation_id)
```

---

## 8.5 Kinerja

TOPSIS menggunakan **NumPy vectorized operations** (bukan loop Python murni seperti Node.js).

| Metrik | Node.js (TS) | Python (NumPy) |
|--------|-------------|----------------|
| 1 donasi, 50 recipients | ~15ms | ~2ms |
| 100 donasi, 50 recipients | ~1.5s | ~0.2s |
| Synchronous? | Ya (better-sqlite3) | Ya (sync engine untuk TOPSIS) |

**Sync engine:** TOPSIS menggunakan sync SQLAlchemy engine terpisah (bukan async) karena komputasi berat. Engine di-cache — dibuat sekali, reusable.

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — TOPSIS Algorithm

## 5 Kriteria

| Kode | Kriteria | Tipe | Benefit/Cost | Sumber Data |
|------|----------|------|--------------|-------------|
| C1 | Densitas Protein | `min(100, (totalProtein / dailyProteinNeed) * 100)` | Benefit | Donasi × RecipientProfile |
| C2 | Urgensi Kesehatan | `emergency === "active" ? urgency * 1000 : urgency` | Benefit | RecipientProfile |
| C3 | Kelayakan Pangan | `max((validUntil - now) / 3600000, 0.1)` dalam jam | Benefit | Donation.valid_until |
| C4 | Jangkauan Lokasi | Haversine(pickup_lat/lon → recipient_lat/lon) dalam km | Cost | Donation + RecipientProfile |
| C5 | Riwayat Bantuan | `max((now - lastReceived) / 86400000, 0)` dalam hari, default 30 | Benefit | RecipientProfile.last_received_donation |

## Proses Perhitungan

### 1. Normalisasi Vektor

```
norm_factors[j] = sqrt(sum(matrix[i][j]^2))
norm_matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j] / norm_factors[j]
```

### 2. Shannon Entropy — Bobot Objektif

```
p_matrix[i][j] = norm_matrix[i][j] / sum(norm_matrix[][j])
entropy[j] = -k * sum(p_matrix[i][j] * log(p_matrix[i][j]))
  where k = 1/ln(m)
d_j = max(0, 1 - entropy[j])
w_j = d_j / sum(d_j)
```

### 3. Weighted Normalized Matrix

```
v_matrix[i][j] = norm_matrix[i][j] * w_j[j]
```

### 4. Solusi Ideal

```
A_plus[j]  = max(v_matrix[][j]) jika benefit, min jika cost
A_minus[j] = min(v_matrix[][j]) jika benefit, max jika cost
```

### 5. Euclidean Distance

```
D_plus[i]  = sqrt(sum((v_matrix[i][j] - A_plus[j])^2))
D_minus[i] = sqrt(sum((v_matrix[i][j] - A_minus[j])^2))
```

### 6. Closeness Coefficient

```
CI[i] = D_minus[i] / (D_plus[i] + D_minus[i])
```

### 7. Ranking

```
Ranking = sort(CI, descending)
CI tertinggi = Priority #1 → berhak klaim
```

## Edge Cases

| Kasus | Penanganan |
|-------|-----------|
| Protein need = 0 | C1 = 0 |
| Jarak = 0 | C4 = 0 (pinpoint sama) |
| Hanya 1 recipient | Langsung rank 1, CI = 1 (skip entropy) |
| Tidak ada recipient | Return (no ranking) |
| Sum entropy = 0 | Bobot seragam (1/n) |
| Division by zero | Guard dengan EPSILON = 1e-12 |

## Trigger TOPSIS

| Event | Aksi |
|-------|------|
| Donasi baru dipublikasi | `calculate_topsis_for_donation(donation_id)` |
| Admin verifikasi penerima | `run_topsis_all_active()` |

# PRD NUTRI-SHARE — Notifikasi & Gamification

## Notifikasi Real-Time (SSE)

### Metode

Server-Sent Events via `GET /api/notifications/subscribe?user_id=N`

### Cara Kerja

```
Browser → EventSource("/api/notifications/subscribe?user_id=7")
  → Server set header: Content-Type: text/event-stream
  → Server kirim: "data: connected\n\n"
  → Server kirim event setiap ada notifikasi baru
  → 30s keepalive ping: ":ping\n\n"
  → Browser terima → update state React + toast notif
```

### Tipe Notifikasi

| Tipe | Trigger | Penerima | Pesan |
|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `donation_available` | Donasi dipublikasi | Semua penerima verified | "Donasi Tersedia! Donasi {food} sejumlah {n} porsi telah dipublikasikan" |
| `claim_approved` | Admin setujui klaim | Donor + penerima terkait | "Klaim Disetujui! Donasi {food} telah disetujui" |
| `verification` | Admin verifikasi user | User terverifikasi | "Akun Anda telah diverifikasi" |
| `system` | Klaim baru | Admin | "Klaim Baru! Donasi {food} diklaim oleh {institution}" |

### Polling Fallback

Frontend juga polling `GET /api/notifications?user_id=N` setiap 30 detik sebagai fallback jika SSE gagal.

## Gamification

### Badges Donor

| Badge | Syarat | Icon |
|-------|--------|------|
| Donator Pemula | ≥ 1 donasi | 🌱 |
| Donator Aktif | ≥ 5 donasi | ⭐ |
| Pahlawan Pangan | ≥ 10 donasi | 🏆 |
| Legenda Donasi | ≥ 20 donasi | 👑 |
| Favorit Penerima | ≥ 5 ulasan positif | ❤️ |

### Perhitungan Badges

```python
def calculate_badges(total_donations: int, review_count: int) -> list[dict]:
    badges = []
    if total_donations >= 1:  badges.append({"name": "Donator Pemula", ...})
    if total_donations >= 5:  badges.append({"name": "Donator Aktif", ...})
    if total_donations >= 10: badges.append({"name": "Pahlawan Pangan", ...})
    if total_donations >= 20: badges.append({"name": "Legenda Donasi", ...})
    if review_count >= 5:     badges.append({"name": "Favorit Penerima", ...})
    return badges
```

### Top Donors

3 besar donor ditampilkan di halaman **Pahlawan** (`/pahlawan`)

```
SELECT * FROM donor_profiles ORDER BY total_donations DESC LIMIT 3
```

Setiap donor menampilkan:
- Nama bisnis
- Jumlah donasi
- Rating rata-rata (dari reviews)
- Jumlah ulasan
- Logo (jika ada)

## 10.1 Flow Donasi Lengkap

═══════════════════════
                        ┌─────────────┐
Donor ───► Register ──►│  STATUS:    │──► Login

                        └──────┬──────┘
                               │ Admin verifikasi
                               ▼
                        ┌─────────────┐
                        │  STATUS:    │──► Bisa buat donasi
                        │  verified   │
                        └─────────────┘

Penerima ─► Register ──► sama (pending → verified)
  (panti/lembaga)

PUBLIKASI DONASI
════════════════
Donor (verified) ───► POST /api/donations ───► STATUS: active

TOPSIS RANKING
══════════════
Sistem ──► calculate_topsis_for_donation(id)
            │
            ├── Cari semua penerima verified
            ├── Build decision matrix (C1-C5)
            ├── Entropy → bobot
            ├── Normalisasi → weighted
            ├── Ideal solution → CI Score
            └── Rank 1..N

            Notifikasi ──► SSE: "Donasi Tersedia!" ke semua penerima

PENERIMA LIHAT & KLAIM
══════════════════════
Penerima (verified) ──► GET /api/donations/active?recipient_id=N
                         │
                         └── Response: ranked by TOPSIS CI score
                              [ { rank: 1, ci_score: 0.85, ... }, ... ]

Penerima ──► POST /api/donations/{id}/claim
              │
              ├── INSERT claim (status: pending)
              ├── Notifikasi ──► SSE: "Klaim Baru!" ke admin
              └── Activity log: klaim_buat

ADMIN APPROVE
═════════════
Admin ──► GET /api/admin/claims (list pending)
         │
         └── POST /api/admin/claims/{id}/approve
              │
              ├── UPDATE claim (status: approved)
              ├── UPDATE donation (status: claimed, claimed_by, claimed_at)
              └── Notifikasi ──► SSE ke donor + penerima: "Klaim Disetujui!"

PENGIRIMAN
══════════
Penerima ──► POST /api/donations/{id}/arrived  ← Konfirmasi kurir sampai
              │
              ├── UPDATE donation (arrived_at)
              │
Donor ────► POST /api/donations/{id}/complete  ← Konfirmasi selesai
              │
              ├── UPDATE donation (status: completed, completed_at)
              ├── UPDATE donor_profiles (total_donations +1)
              ├── UPDATE recipient_profiles (last_received_donation)
              └── Activity log: donasi_selesai

REVIEW
══════
Penerima ──► POST /api/reviews
              │
              ├── INSERT review
              ├── Notifikasi ──► SSE ke donor: "Ulasan Baru!"
              └── Activity log: ulasan_buat

Donor ────► GET /api/donors/{id}/badges (ceklag badges terbaru)
```

---

## 10.2 State Machine

### 10.2.1 Status Donasi

```
                    ┌──────────┐
         ┌─────────►│  active  │◄────────────┐
         │          └────┬─────┘             │
         │               │                   │
         │      Penerima klaim (rank #1)     │
         │               ▼                   │
         │          ┌──────────┐             │
         │          │  claimed  │            │
         │          └────┬─────┘             │
         │               │                   │
         │        Admin approve              │
         │               ▼                   │
         │          ┌──────────┐             │
         │          │  claimed  │            │
         │          │(arrived) │             │
         │          └────┬─────┘             │
         │               │                   │
         │      Penerima konfirmasi sampai   │
         │      Donor konfirmasi selesai     │
         │               ▼                   │
         │          ┌───────────┐            │
         │          │ completed │            │
         │          └───────────┘            │
         │                                   │
         └── expired (jika lewat valid_until)┘
```

### 10.2.2 Status User

```
        ┌──────────┐
        │  pending │  ← Baru daftar
        └────┬─────┘
             │ Admin verifikasi
             ▼
   ┌─────────────────┐
   │    verified      │  ← Bisa login & pakai fitur
   └─────────────────┘

   ┌─────────────────┐
   │    rejected      │  ← Ditolak admin
   └─────────────────┘
```

### 10.2.3 Status Emergency

```
Penerima: none ──► pending ──► active ──► none
              │        │           │
              │        ▼           │
              │   (toggle)         │
              │   Minta bantuan    │
              │                    ▼
              │           (admin toggle)
              │           Selesai darurat
              ▼
        (toggle langsung)
        Batalkan permintaan
```

## 10.3 Status Badge Visual

| Status Donasi | Label | Warna (bg) | Warna (text) |
|--------------|-------|-----------|-------------|
| active | AKTIF | `#E8F5E9` | `#2D7A4F` |

## 10.4 AKG Gizi Harian

### 10.4.1 Perhitungan

```
Endpoint: GET /api/recipient/akg?user_id=7

Input:
  - RecipientProfile.daily_protein_need, daily_calorie_need,
    daily_iron_need, daily_vitamin_c_need
  - Donations hari ini (completed, claimed_by = user_id)

Proses:
  1. Cari semua donations hari ini (00:00:00 - 23:59:59)
     WHERE claimed_by = user_id AND status = 'completed'
  
  2. Total protein = SUM(protein_per_portion * portion_count)
     Total calories = SUM(calorie_per_portion * portion_count)
     Total iron = SUM(iron_mg * portion_count)
     Total vitamin_c = SUM(vitamin_c_mg * portion_count)

  3. Persentase = min(100, round(total / daily_need * 100))
     Overall = round((protein% + cal% + iron% + vitC%) / 4)
```

  │    • Rating & komentar       │    • Rating 1-5            │
  │    • Badge "Favorit"         │    • Komentar               │
```

## Status Donasi

```
                    ┌──────────┐
                    │  active  │  ← Donasi dipublikasi
                    └────┬─────┘
                         │ Penerima klaim (priority #1)
                         ▼
                    ┌──────────┐
                    │  claimed  │  ← Admin approve
                    └────┬─────┘
                         │ Kurir antar
                         ▼
                    ┌──────────┐
                    │  arrived  │  ← (field arrived_at, bukan status)
                    └────┬─────┘
                         │ Donor konfirmasi selesai
                         ▼
                    ┌───────────┐
                    │ completed  │  ← Selesai!
                    └───────────┘

         active ──► expired (jika lewat valid_until)
```

## Status User

```
┌─────────┐
│ pending │  ← Baru daftar, menunggu admin
└────┬────┘
     │ Admin verifikasi
     ▼
┌──────────┐
│ verified  │  ← Bisa login & pakai fitur
└──────────┘

┌──────────┐
│ rejected  │  ← Ditolak admin
└──────────┘
```

## Emergency Status (Penerima)

```
none ──► pending ──► active ──► none
  │         │            │
  │         ▼            │
  └── (toggle)           │
       Penerima         └── (admin toggle)
       minta bantuan        Selesai darurat
```

## AKG Gizi Harian

Perhitungan di endpoint `GET /api/recipient/akg?user_id=7`

```
1. Cari semua donations completed hari ini untuk user
2. Total protein = sum(protein_per_portion * portion_count)
3. Total kalori  = sum(calorie_per_portion * portion_count)
4. Total zat besi = sum(iron_mg * portion_count)
5. Total vitamin C = sum(vitamin_c_mg * portion_count)
6. Persentase:
   protein_pct = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
   kalori_pct  = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
   fe_pct      = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
   vitc_pct    = min(100, total / daily_need * 100)
7. Overall = rata-rata 4 persentase
```

## Palet Warna

| Role | Warna | Kode | Penggunaan |
|------|-------|------|------------|
